title: 福島氫能研究場
subcategoryTitleEn: Landmark storage, transmission and hydrogen projects
summary: 福島縣浪江町的氫能研究場建在 2011 年核災後閒置的土地上：20 MW 的太陽能板為一座 10 MW 的鹼性水電解裝置供電，2020 年啟用時是世界上最大級的再生能源製氫設施。它研究的不只是製氫，更是「用電解槽當作電網的可調負載」：太陽能多的時候多製氫，電網吃緊的時候少製氫，不必用電池也能平衡供需。課程定量分析太陽能的發電量、產氫量與效率、壓縮與拖車運送、功率的調節範圍、氫再轉成電的效率與洩漏時的通風。
summaryEn: The Fukushima Hydrogen Energy Research Field at Namie stands on land left idle after the 2011 nuclear accident: 20 MW of solar panels feed a 10 MW alkaline water electrolyser, among the largest renewable hydrogen facilities in the world when it opened in 2020. Its study is not only making hydrogen but using an electrolyser as an adjustable grid load: more hydrogen when solar is plentiful, less when the grid is tight, balancing supply and demand without batteries. The course quantifies solar generation, hydrogen output and efficiency, compression and trailer haulage, power turndown, efficiency of hydrogen back to electricity and ventilation for leaks.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與標準架構編寫的原創教學。步驟是可驗證的分析、估算與檢核任務，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、運轉程序或作業許可。核能內容僅限公開的熱循環、功能架構、土木與安全理念，不包含燃料製備、濃縮、再處理、武器、反應度整定、反應爐操作或保安細節。數值為公開標稱值或教學假設，實際工程須由合格專業人員依規範與實測資料重新計算並負責。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and standards frameworks. Steps are verifiable analysis, estimation and checking tasks, not drawings, method statements, operating procedures or permits. Nuclear content is limited to public thermal cycles, functional architecture, civil works and safety concepts and excludes fuel production, enrichment, reprocessing, weapons, reactivity settings, reactor operation and security details. Numbers are public nominal values or teaching assumptions; real work must be recalculated by qualified professionals using codes and measured data.

nodes: 輸電線路、電纜或儲存介質
Transmission line, cable or storage medium

v30Focus: 用太陽能製氫來平衡電網：產氫量、電解效率、壓縮與運送、功率的調節範圍、再轉成電的效率與通風
v30FocusEn: Balancing a grid by making hydrogen from solar: output, electrolysis efficiency, compression and haulage, power turndown, efficiency back to electricity and ventilation

stages.title: 資源、需求與系統架構：福島氫能研究場
stages.titleEn: Resource, demand and system architecture: Fukushima Hydrogen Energy Research Field (FH2R)
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「年發電量與性能比」與「產氫量的體積與質量」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Annual yield and performance ratio" and "Hydrogen output by volume and mass": build the mechanism and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

quiz.question: 關於「年發電量與性能比」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Annual yield and performance ratio" is correct?
options: 光電廠的年發電量等於直流裝置容量、模組面上的年日射量與性能比三者的乘積。
太陽能電廠的發電量只和日照強度有關，與溫度無關。
氫氣很輕，所以它含的能量很少。
optionsEn: Annual energy of a PV plant is the product of DC capacity, yearly irradiation on the module plane and performance ratio.
The output of a solar plant depends only on sunlight intensity, not temperature.
Hydrogen is light and so holds little energy.
quiz.explanation: 光電廠的年發電量等於直流裝置容量、模組面上的年日射量與性能比三者的乘積。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Annual energy of a PV plant is the product of DC capacity, yearly irradiation on the module plane and performance ratio. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 年發電量與性能比：機制與能量路徑
steps.titleEn: Annual yield and performance ratio: mechanism and energy path
steps.objective: 說明「年發電量與性能比」如何決定「福島氫能研究場」的能量轉換、輸送、儲存或安全功能，並畫出輸入、轉換、損失與系統邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Annual yield and performance ratio” governs energy conversion, transfer, storage or safety functions in “Fukushima Hydrogen Energy Research Field (FH2R)”, and map inputs, conversions, losses and the system boundary.
steps.instruction: 光電廠的年發電量等於直流裝置容量、模組面上的年日射量與性能比三者的乘積。性能比（PR）把所有損失歸併成一個數字：溫度、髒污、遮蔭、線損、逆變器效率與停機，設計良好的大型電廠約為 0.78 至 0.85。同樣的模組放在日射量高出五成的沙漠，發電量未必多五成，因為高溫使性能比下降。 師傅任務：畫出這個單元的能量與物質流圖（輸入、轉換、損失、輸出、邊界），標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由資源、環境或運轉決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Annual energy of a PV plant is the product of DC capacity, yearly irradiation on the module plane and performance ratio. PR gathers all losses into one number — temperature, soiling, shading, wiring, inverter efficiency and downtime — and is about 0.78–0.85 for a well-designed utility plant. The same modules in a desert with 50% more irradiation do not necessarily yield 50% more, because heat lowers PR. Mentor task: draw the energy and material flow of this unit (inputs, conversions, losses, outputs, boundary), mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by resource, environment or operation, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 工程檔案：水電解裝置的最大輸入功率為 10 MW
steps.observationEn: Project file: The water electrolyser has a maximum input of 10 MW
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「太陽能電廠的發電量只和日照強度有關，與溫度無關。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在流程圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "The output of a solar plant depends only on sunlight intensity, not temperature." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your flow diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 流程圖標明「年發電量與性能比」的輸入、轉換、損失與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The flow diagram shows inputs, conversions, losses and boundary for “Annual yield and performance ratio”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 年發電量與性能比
knowledge.text: 光電廠的年發電量等於直流裝置容量、模組面上的年日射量與性能比三者的乘積。性能比（PR）把所有損失歸併成一個數字：溫度、髒污、遮蔭、線損、逆變器效率與停機，設計良好的大型電廠約為 0.78 至 0.85。同樣的模組放在日射量高出五成的沙漠，發電量未必多五成，因為高溫使性能比下降。
knowledge.textEn: Annual energy of a PV plant is the product of DC capacity, yearly irradiation on the module plane and performance ratio. PR gathers all losses into one number — temperature, soiling, shading, wiring, inverter efficiency and downtime — and is about 0.78–0.85 for a well-designed utility plant. The same modules in a desert with 50% more irradiation do not necessarily yield 50% more, because heat lowers PR.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：太陽能電廠的發電量只和日照強度有關，與溫度無關。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: The output of a solar plant depends only on sunlight intensity, not temperature. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

knowledge.title: 工程檔案
knowledge.text: 水電解裝置的最大輸入功率為 10 MW
knowledge.textEn: The water electrolyser has a maximum input of 10 MW

quiz.question: 依「年發電量與性能比」的模型 E = P_dc·H·PR，依模組面年日射量估算的年發電量（日射量與 PR 為代表值）最接近下列何者？
quiz.questionEn: Using the model E = P_dc·H·PR for "Annual yield and performance ratio", which value is closest to the annual energy from plane-of-array irradiation (irradiation and PR representative)?
options: 10.4 GWh
20.8 GWh
208 GWh
optionsEn: 10.4 GWh
20.8 GWh
208 GWh
quiz.explanation: E = P_dc·H·PR；代入 Pdc = 20 MWp、GHI = 1300 kWh/m²、PR = 0.8，得 20.8 GWh（依模組面年日射量估算的年發電量（日射量與 PR 為代表值））。 其餘選項是倍數或數量級錯誤。
quiz.explanationEn: E = P_dc·H·PR; with Pdc = 20 MWp, GHI = 1300 kWh/m², PR = 0.8 the result is 20.8 GWh (annual energy from plane-of-array irradiation (irradiation and PR representative)). The other options are factor or order-of-magnitude errors.

steps.title: 年發電量與性能比：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Annual yield and performance ratio: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「年發電量與性能比」的關鍵量，並判斷輸入改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantity of “Annual yield and performance ratio” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when an input moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：E = P_dc·H·PR；代入 Pdc = 20 MWp、GHI = 1300 kWh/m²、PR = 0.8，得 20.8 GWh（依模組面年日射量估算的年發電量（日射量與 PR 為代表值））。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次；再把 PR 增加 10%，先預測再計算輸出，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出設計或規範通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: E = P_dc·H·PR; with Pdc = 20 MWp, GHI = 1300 kWh/m², PR = 0.8 the result is 20.8 GWh (annual energy from plane-of-array irradiation (irradiation and PR representative)). Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units; then raise PR by 10%, predict before computing the output, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how designers or codes usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 敏感度核對：PR 增加 10% 時，結果變為 22.9 GWh（+10.0%）。
steps.observationEn: Sensitivity check: Raising PR by 10% changes the result to 22.9 GWh (+10.0%).
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成實機設計值、混淆額定值與實際運轉值，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as plant design values, mixing rated and actual operating values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later decisions.
steps.check: 重現 20.8 GWh（取整誤差 ±2% 內），並提交 PR 改變 10% 的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce 20.8 GWh (within ±2% rounding) and submit the sensitivity calculation for a 10% change in PR with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: E = P_dc·H·PR；代入 Pdc = 20 MWp、GHI = 1300 kWh/m²、PR = 0.8，得 20.8 GWh（依模組面年日射量估算的年發電量（日射量與 PR 為代表值））。
knowledge.textEn: E = P_dc·H·PR; with Pdc = 20 MWp, GHI = 1300 kWh/m², PR = 0.8 the result is 20.8 GWh (annual energy from plane-of-array irradiation (irradiation and PR representative)).

knowledge.title: 敏感度
knowledge.text: PR 增加 10% 時，結果變為 22.9 GWh（+10.0%）。 先預測方向與次方，再用計算確認。
knowledge.textEn: Raising PR by 10% changes the result to 22.9 GWh (+10.0%). Predict direction and exponent first, then confirm by calculation.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為公開標稱值或教學假設的簡化；套用到實際設備前，必須依規範、製造商資料與現場量測重新計算。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are public nominal values or simplified teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, recalculate with codes, manufacturer data and site measurements.

quiz.question: 要驗證「年發電量與性能比」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Annual yield and performance ratio"?
options: 量測時不必記錄環境溫度、負載與運轉模式，因為它們不影響結果。
氫氣可以像天然氣一樣方便地用卡車運送。
依 IEC 61724-1 以校正過的日射計量測模組面日射量，配合關口電表計算逐月性能比，並做溫度修正後與設計模擬（如 PVsyst）比較。
optionsEn: Ambient temperature, load and operating mode need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Hydrogen can be trucked as easily as natural gas.

Under IEC 61724-1 measure plane-of-array irradiance with calibrated pyranometers, compute monthly PR with revenue-meter energy, apply temperature correction and compare with design simulation such as PVsyst.
quiz.explanation: 依 IEC 61724-1 以校正過的日射計量測模組面日射量，配合關口電表計算逐月性能比，並做溫度修正後與設計模擬（如 PVsyst）比較。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Under IEC 61724-1 measure plane-of-array irradiance with calibrated pyranometers, compute monthly PR with revenue-meter energy, apply temperature correction and compare with design simulation such as PVsyst. Verification needs a baseline, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 年發電量與性能比：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Annual yield and performance ratio: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「年發電量與性能比」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停留點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Annual yield and performance ratio” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 依 IEC 61724-1 以校正過的日射計量測模組面日射量，配合關口電表計算逐月性能比，並做溫度修正後與設計模擬（如 PVsyst）比較。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器、基準或校正、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停留點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Under IEC 61724-1 measure plane-of-array irradiance with calibrated pyranometers, compute monthly PR with revenue-meter energy, apply temperature correction and compare with design simulation such as PVsyst. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments, baseline or calibration, procedure, comparison, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：性能驗收要同時約定日射計等級、清潔頻率與溫度修正方法，否則 PR 數字無法比較。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Performance acceptance should fix pyranometer class, cleaning frequency and temperature-correction method, or PR figures cannot be compared.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：日射計髒污或傾角安裝錯誤會使量到的日射量偏低、性能比虛高，掩蓋了真正的發電損失。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境與運轉條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A dirty or misaligned pyranometer reads irradiation low and inflates PR, hiding real generation losses. A single reading, no traceable baseline, or unrecorded ambient and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停留點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, baseline, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 依 IEC 61724-1 以校正過的日射計量測模組面日射量，配合關口電表計算逐月性能比，並做溫度修正後與設計模擬（如 PVsyst）比較。
knowledge.textEn: Under IEC 61724-1 measure plane-of-array irradiance with calibrated pyranometers, compute monthly PR with revenue-meter energy, apply temperature correction and compare with design simulation such as PVsyst.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 性能驗收要同時約定日射計等級、清潔頻率與溫度修正方法，否則 PR 數字無法比較。
knowledge.textEn: Performance acceptance should fix pyranometer class, cleaning frequency and temperature-correction method, or PR figures cannot be compared.

knowledge.title: 規範與標準
knowledge.text: 可對照的公開規範或指引：IEC 62271 高壓開關設備與控制設備。引用時須確認版次與適用範圍。
knowledge.textEn: A public code or guide to compare against: IEC 62271 High-voltage switchgear and controlgear. Confirm edition and applicability before citing it.

quiz.question: 在「年發電量與性能比」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Annual yield and performance ratio" shows an anomaly, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 日射計髒污或傾角安裝錯誤會使量到的日射量偏低、性能比虛高，掩蓋了真正的發電損失。
所有異常都是操作人員失誤，設計、製造與維護不需要檢討。
氫氣很輕，所以它含的能量很少。
optionsEn: A dirty or misaligned pyranometer reads irradiation low and inflates PR, hiding real generation losses.
Every anomaly is operator error, so design, manufacturing and maintenance never need review.
Hydrogen is light and so holds little energy.
quiz.explanation: 日射計髒污或傾角安裝錯誤會使量到的日射量偏低、性能比虛高，掩蓋了真正的發電損失。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: A dirty or misaligned pyranometer reads irradiation low and inflates PR, hiding real generation losses. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 年發電量與性能比：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Annual yield and performance ratio: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「年發電量與性能比」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or degradation causes of “Annual yield and performance ratio” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 日射計髒污或傾角安裝錯誤會使量到的日射量偏低、性能比虛高，掩蓋了真正的發電損失。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢查，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響「福島氫能研究場」的安全、出力、壽命或併網。
steps.instructionEn: A dirty or misaligned pyranometer reads irradiation low and inflates PR, hiding real generation losses. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects safety, output, life or grid connection of “Fukushima Hydrogen Energy Research Field (FH2R)”.
steps.observation: 連結機制：同樣的模組放在日射量高出五成的沙漠，發電量未必多五成，因為高溫使性能比下降。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The same modules in a desert with 50% more irradiation do not necessarily yield 50% more, because heat lowers PR.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「太陽能電廠的發電量只和日照強度有關，與溫度無關。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "The output of a solar plant depends only on sunlight intensity, not temperature." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢查能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 日射計髒污或傾角安裝錯誤會使量到的日射量偏低、性能比虛高，掩蓋了真正的發電損失。
knowledge.textEn: A dirty or misaligned pyranometer reads irradiation low and inflates PR, hiding real generation losses.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢查確認；只更換設備、重設警報或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; swapping equipment, resetting alarms or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

knowledge.title: 工程年表
knowledge.text: 2018：研究場開始興建
knowledge.textEn: 2018: Construction of the research field began

quiz.question: 關於「產氫量的體積與質量」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Hydrogen output by volume and mass" is correct?
options: 氫氣很輕，所以它含的能量很少。
用再生能源電力製氫再發電，可以把電幾乎沒有損失地存起來。
氫氣的產量習慣用「標準立方公尺」表示——在零度、一大氣壓下的體積。
optionsEn: Hydrogen is light and so holds little energy.
Making hydrogen from renewable power and generating from it stores electricity with almost no loss.
Hydrogen output is usually given in normal cubic metres, volume at zero degrees and one atmosphere.
quiz.explanation: 氫氣的產量習慣用「標準立方公尺」表示——在零度、一大氣壓下的體積。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Hydrogen output is usually given in normal cubic metres, volume at zero degrees and one atmosphere. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 產氫量的體積與質量：機制與能量路徑
steps.titleEn: Hydrogen output by volume and mass: mechanism and energy path
steps.objective: 說明「產氫量的體積與質量」如何決定「福島氫能研究場」的能量轉換、輸送、儲存或安全功能，並畫出輸入、轉換、損失與系統邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Hydrogen output by volume and mass” governs energy conversion, transfer, storage or safety functions in “Fukushima Hydrogen Energy Research Field (FH2R)”, and map inputs, conversions, losses and the system boundary.
steps.instruction: 氫氣的產量習慣用「標準立方公尺」表示——在零度、一大氣壓下的體積。氫是最輕的氣體，一標準立方公尺只有零點零九公斤，不到空氣的十四分之一。每小時一千兩百標準立方公尺聽起來很多，換算成質量只有一百公斤出頭。但氫每公斤所含的能量是汽油的三倍；一百公斤氫可以讓燃料電池車跑一萬公里以上。處理氫的工程難題幾乎都來自這個性質：以質量計它是能量最密集的燃料，以體積計卻是最稀薄的。 師傅任務：畫出這個單元的能量與物質流圖（輸入、轉換、損失、輸出、邊界），標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由資源、環境或運轉決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Hydrogen output is usually given in normal cubic metres, volume at zero degrees and one atmosphere. Hydrogen is the lightest gas, a normal cubic metre weighing only 0.09 kilograms, under a fourteenth of air. Twelve hundred normal cubic metres an hour sounds much but is a little over a hundred kilograms. Yet hydrogen holds three times the energy of petrol per kilogram, a hundred kilograms taking fuel-cell cars over ten thousand kilometres. Nearly every engineering difficulty with hydrogen comes from this: by mass it is the most energy-dense fuel and by volume the thinnest. Mentor task: draw the energy and material flow of this unit (inputs, conversions, losses, outputs, boundary), mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by resource, environment or operation, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.observationEn: Project file: Solar capacity on site is 20 MW

steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Hydrogen is light and so holds little energy." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your flow diagram where it breaks down.

quiz.question: 依「產氫量的體積與質量」的模型 ṁ = Q·ρ，每小時 1,200 Nm³、標準狀態密度 0.0899 kg/Nm³ 時的質量流量最接近下列何者？
quiz.questionEn: Using the model ṁ = Q·ρ for "Hydrogen output by volume and mass", which value is closest to the mass flow of 1,200 Nm³ an hour at a normal density of 0.0899 kg/Nm³?
options: 108 kg/h
optionsEn: 108 kg/h
quiz.explanation: ṁ = Q·ρ；代入 Q = 1200 Nm³/h、ρ = 0.0899 kg/Nm³，得 108 kg/h（每小時 1,200 Nm³、標準狀態密度 0.0899 kg/Nm³ 時的質量流量）。 其餘選項是倍數或數量級錯誤。
quiz.explanationEn: ṁ = Q·ρ; with Q = 1200 Nm³/h, ρ = 0.0899 kg/Nm³ the result is 108 kg/h (mass flow of 1,200 Nm³ an hour at a normal density of 0.0899 kg/Nm³). The other options are factor or order-of-magnitude errors.

steps.title: 產氫量的體積與質量：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Hydrogen output by volume and mass: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「產氫量的體積與質量」的關鍵量，並判斷輸入改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantity of “Hydrogen output by volume and mass” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when an input moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：ṁ = Q·ρ；代入 Q = 1200 Nm³/h、ρ = 0.0899 kg/Nm³，得 108 kg/h（每小時 1,200 Nm³、標準狀態密度 0.0899 kg/Nm³ 時的質量流量）。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次；再把 Q 增加 10%，先預測再計算輸出，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出設計或規範通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: ṁ = Q·ρ; with Q = 1200 Nm³/h, ρ = 0.0899 kg/Nm³ the result is 108 kg/h (mass flow of 1,200 Nm³ an hour at a normal density of 0.0899 kg/Nm³). Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units; then raise Q by 10%, predict before computing the output, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how designers or codes usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 敏感度核對：Q 增加 10% 時，結果變為 119 kg/h（+10.0%）。
steps.observationEn: Sensitivity check: Raising Q by 10% changes the result to 119 kg/h (+10.0%).
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成實機設計值、混淆額定值與實際運轉值，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as plant design values, mixing rated and actual operating values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later decisions.
steps.check: 重現 108 kg/h（取整誤差 ±2% 內），並提交 Q 改變 10% 的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce 108 kg/h (within ±2% rounding) and submit the sensitivity calculation for a 10% change in Q with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: ṁ = Q·ρ；代入 Q = 1200 Nm³/h、ρ = 0.0899 kg/Nm³，得 108 kg/h（每小時 1,200 Nm³、標準狀態密度 0.0899 kg/Nm³ 時的質量流量）。
knowledge.textEn: ṁ = Q·ρ; with Q = 1200 Nm³/h, ρ = 0.0899 kg/Nm³ the result is 108 kg/h (mass flow of 1,200 Nm³ an hour at a normal density of 0.0899 kg/Nm³).

knowledge.title: 敏感度
knowledge.text: Q 增加 10% 時，結果變為 119 kg/h（+10.0%）。 先預測方向與次方，再用計算確認。
knowledge.textEn: Raising Q by 10% changes the result to 119 kg/h (+10.0%). Predict direction and exponent first, then confirm by calculation.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為公開標稱值或教學假設的簡化；套用到實際設備前，必須依規範、製造商資料與現場量測重新計算。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are public nominal values or simplified teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, recalculate with codes, manufacturer data and site measurements.

quiz.question: 要驗證「產氫量的體積與質量」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Hydrogen output by volume and mass"?
options: 沿用另一座電廠或另一台機組的試驗結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
以質量流量計量測產氫量，並以線上分析儀確認氫氣的純度與含氧、含水量。
用電解水製造的氫，一定是零碳的。
optionsEn: Reusing test results from another plant or unit counts as verifying this project.
A mass flow meter measures hydrogen output, and on-line analysers confirm purity and oxygen and moisture content.
Hydrogen made by electrolysis is always zero-carbon.
quiz.explanation: 以質量流量計量測產氫量，並以線上分析儀確認氫氣的純度與含氧、含水量。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: A mass flow meter measures hydrogen output, and on-line analysers confirm purity and oxygen and moisture content. Verification needs a baseline, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 產氫量的體積與質量：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Hydrogen output by volume and mass: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「產氫量的體積與質量」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停留點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Hydrogen output by volume and mass” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以質量流量計量測產氫量，並以線上分析儀確認氫氣的純度與含氧、含水量。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器、基準或校正、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停留點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: A mass flow meter measures hydrogen output, and on-line analysers confirm purity and oxygen and moisture content. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments, baseline or calibration, procedure, comparison, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：氫的數量要註明是質量或何種條件下的體積，設計與交易以質量為基準。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: State whether hydrogen quantity is mass or volume at given conditions, basing design and trade on mass.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：把標準立方公尺與實際狀態下的立方公尺混為一談時，儲槽與管線的容量估算相差數十倍到數百倍。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境與運轉條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Confusing normal cubic metres with cubic metres at actual conditions puts tank and pipe sizing out by tens to hundreds of times. A single reading, no traceable baseline, or unrecorded ambient and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停留點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, baseline, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

quiz.question: 在「產氫量的體積與質量」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Hydrogen output by volume and mass" shows an anomaly, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 把警報門檻調寬，就能解決大多數異常。
用再生能源電力製氫再發電，可以把電幾乎沒有損失地存起來。
把標準立方公尺與實際狀態下的立方公尺混為一談時，儲槽與管線的容量估算相差數十倍到數百倍。
optionsEn: Widening the alarm thresholds resolves most anomalies.
Making hydrogen from renewable power and generating from it stores electricity with almost no loss.
Confusing normal cubic metres with cubic metres at actual conditions puts tank and pipe sizing out by tens to hundreds of times.
quiz.explanation: 把標準立方公尺與實際狀態下的立方公尺混為一談時，儲槽與管線的容量估算相差數十倍到數百倍。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Confusing normal cubic metres with cubic metres at actual conditions puts tank and pipe sizing out by tens to hundreds of times. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「產氫量的體積與質量」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or degradation causes of “Hydrogen output by volume and mass” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 把標準立方公尺與實際狀態下的立方公尺混為一談時，儲槽與管線的容量估算相差數十倍到數百倍。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢查，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響「福島氫能研究場」的安全、出力、壽命或併網。
steps.instructionEn: Confusing normal cubic metres with cubic metres at actual conditions puts tank and pipe sizing out by tens to hundreds of times. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects safety, output, life or grid connection of “Fukushima Hydrogen Energy Research Field (FH2R)”.
steps.observation: 連結機制：處理氫的工程難題幾乎都來自這個性質：以質量計它是能量最密集的燃料，以體積計卻是最稀薄的。

steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「氫氣很輕，所以它含的能量很少。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Hydrogen is light and so holds little energy." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢查能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 把標準立方公尺與實際狀態下的立方公尺混為一談時，儲槽與管線的容量估算相差數十倍到數百倍。
knowledge.textEn: Confusing normal cubic metres with cubic metres at actual conditions puts tank and pipe sizing out by tens to hundreds of times.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢查確認；只更換設備、重設警報或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; swapping equipment, resetting alarms or relaxing limits can mask the problem.
